key_insight: FrontierOR challenges LLM agents to design scalable optimization algorithms, moving beyond one-shot code generation toward iterative design, testing, and improvement.
engineering_relevance: Successful agentic workflows could reduce the specialist effort needed to tailor routing, scheduling, and network design algorithms.
method: Stage 1 releases 60 audited problems across six application categories and five formulation types, in weekly rounds of 15.
Stage 2 tests generalization on new problems outside the benchmark with unseen instances.
Separate sandboxed Main and Self-hosted tracks check feasibility and score objective ratios against frozen references over hidden instances.
evidence_signal: In FrontierOR's one-shot evaluation, the strongest model achieves an objective within 1% of Gurobi's with no slower runtime on only 39% of large instances.
watch_item: The abstract describes a challenge protocol, not demonstrated gains from iterative agents; scalability and generalization remain to be established.
paper_title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
